comment_text: This is a big one and it took me 9 months to get it. We beat out Bayside Exteriors and I was still about $7K higher. There are some special concessions in this contract. We are putting on 2 pieces of siding that will be provided by the home owner that had previously blown off. There is a decorative beam in his den. He has the beam and just needs us to re attach it to the ceiling. They have requested StormGuard leak barrier instead of StormWatch. All of this has been noted in the contract. Also the ventilation was discussed with Ralph from GAF and he gave my his recommended course of action. It has been noted in CC with a picture showing where placement should be. There will be. Attic fans on the main house, 20’ of ridge vent over the garage on the main house. The garage is adequate with 20’ ridge vent on the main ridge. The deposit they gave me was $22,500 instead of $24k. That was all they had available on that particular card. They agreed to make up the difference on the second draw payment. Please reach out to me with any additional questions.

Shorebirds Company Outing 8/28
Good afternoon everyone!

We are having a Company Outing at the Shorebirds again this year! This is a fun night for everyone to hang out, eat some great food, and enjoy a baseball game together. This year's outing is taking place on Friday, August 28th!

Every employee is invited to bring one guest and join us in the Hardball Cafe, located on the second level behind home plate. There, we will be served a buffet including fried chicken, burgers, hot dogs, and more from 6:30pm-8:30pm. They are also providing us with tea, lemonade, and water during this time. *Additional food and drinks are available for purchase from the stadium's concession stands. 

If you'd like to join us, please RSVP using the form below by end of day on Friday, August 21st. You must RSVP to attend, since tickets are required for entry and will need to be distributed before the game. 

RSVP HERE: https://forms.gle/fVQzeGyayhV3DzcQ7

We look forward to seeing everyone for a fun night of baseball to close out our 2026 Shorebirds season!

comment_text: Very friendly couple. Live in an old farmhouse. Lots of little tight there’s a lot of clutter. They also have a horse. But we should be able to work around it. I was not the first one there they had someone out there they liked me better. I offered better solutions and more knowledge plus the Spicer bros reputation. Ended up vent do an intake vent and a ridge vent. That was kind of added after the fact, so we ended up settling on more or less doing the ventilated price for the price I was before. Spoke to Matt we were able to work it out they said if I could do that, they would sign with me tonight so we went ahead and got them off the street before they could call the other guy back. The roof itself is pretty basic. It does have wood siding that’s gonna need a cut back done. And there are two chimneys that we are eliminating. We are going to do the whole roof and plywood before we shingle it in Atlas pinnacle pristine Woodland Green.

comment_text:
Hutchinson – Punch List

PO #14445

- Front Yard Repair: Repair the trench/rut caused by the dumpster. Add additional soil and seed to restore the disturbed area.

- Post Bases: Need 2 post bases that did not arrive with the material.

- Colonial Post: Replace 1 – 5" x 5" x 9' colonial post due to damage from the manufacturer.

- Vinyl Lattice: Need 1 additional sheet of square vinyl lattice.
  
  - Homeowner has accepted the appearance and style of the square vinyl lattice currently installed.

- Roof Beam / Aluminum Wrap: Homeowner showed contract/change-order language indicating that the new roof beam is to be wrapped in aluminum. Smart Siding to be contracted to come out and install the aluminum wrap.

- Trash Pickup: Remaining trash pile needs to be picked up first of next week.

- Material Returns: There is a large return pile of 2x material on site. Several pieces were unusable due to splitting and poor/damaged edges that were not acceptable for floor decking. See if the supplier can send a Moffett to pick up the return material due to the volume.

- Inspection: Inspection is scheduled for Tuesday. Once the inspection is complete and the outstanding materials arrive, schedule the crew to return and complete the remaining punch-list items.

Current Status: Project is substantially complete. Waiting on the outstanding materials, Tuesday’s inspection, aluminum wrapping of the roof beam, cleanup/returns, and the final punch-list trip.

comment_text:
Hutchinson – Punch List

PO #14445

- Front Yard Repair: Repair the trench/rut caused by the dumpster. Add additional soil and seed to restore the disturbed area.

- Post Bases: Need 2 post bases that did not arrive with the material.

- Colonial Post: Replace 1 – 5" x 5" x 9' colonial post due to damage from the manufacturer.

- Vinyl Lattice: Need 1 additional sheet of square vinyl lattice.
  
  - Homeowner has accepted the appearance and style of the square vinyl lattice currently installed.

- Roof Beam / Aluminum Wrap: Homeowner showed contract/change-order language indicating that the new roof beam is to be wrapped in aluminum. Smart Siding to be contracted to come out and install the aluminum wrap.

- Trash Pickup: Remaining trash pile needs to be picked up first of next week.

- Material Returns: There is a large return pile of 2x material on site. Several pieces were unusable due to splitting and poor/damaged edges that were not acceptable for floor decking. See if the supplier can send a Moffett to pick up the return material due to the volume.

- Inspection: Inspection is scheduled for Tuesday. Once the inspection is complete and the outstanding materials arrive, schedule the crew to return and complete the remaining punch-list items.

Current Status: Project is substantially complete. Waiting on the outstanding materials, Tuesday’s inspection, aluminum wrapping of the roof beam, cleanup/returns, and the final punch-list trip.

comment_text:
Hutchinson – Punch List

PO #14445

- Front Yard Repair: Repair the trench/rut caused by the dumpster. Add additional soil and seed to restore the disturbed area.

- Post Bases: Need 2 post bases that did not arrive with the material.

- Colonial Post: Replace 1 – 5" x 5" x 9' colonial post due to damage from the manufacturer.

- Vinyl Lattice: Need 1 additional sheet of square vinyl lattice.
  
  - Homeowner has accepted the appearance and style of the square vinyl lattice currently installed.

- Roof Beam / Aluminum Wrap: Homeowner showed contract/change-order language indicating that the new roof beam is to be wrapped in aluminum. Smart Siding to be contracted to come out and install the aluminum wrap.

- Trash Pickup: Remaining trash pile needs to be picked up first of next week.

- Material Returns: There is a large return pile of 2x material on site. Several pieces were unusable due to splitting and poor/damaged edges that were not acceptable for floor decking. See if the supplier can send a Moffett to pick up the return material due to the volume.

- Inspection: Inspection is scheduled for Tuesday. Once the inspection is complete and the outstanding materials arrive, schedule the crew to return and complete the remaining punch-list items.

Current Status: Project is substantially complete. Waiting on the outstanding materials, Tuesday’s inspection, aluminum wrapping of the roof beam, cleanup/returns, and the final punch-list trip.

comment_text:
Hutchinson – Punch List

PO #14445

- Front Yard Repair: Repair the trench/rut caused by the dumpster. Add additional soil and seed to restore the disturbed area.

- Post Bases: Need 2 post bases that did not arrive with the material.

- Colonial Post: Replace 1 – 5" x 5" x 9' colonial post due to damage from the manufacturer.

- Vinyl Lattice: Need 1 additional sheet of square vinyl lattice.
  
  - Homeowner has accepted the appearance and style of the square vinyl lattice currently installed.

- Roof Beam / Aluminum Wrap: Homeowner showed contract/change-order language indicating that the new roof beam is to be wrapped in aluminum. Smart Siding to be contracted to come out and install the aluminum wrap.

- Trash Pickup: Remaining trash pile needs to be picked up first of next week.

- Material Returns: There is a large return pile of 2x material on site. Several pieces were unusable due to splitting and poor/damaged edges that were not acceptable for floor decking. See if the supplier can send a Moffett to pick up the return material due to the volume.

- Inspection: Inspection is scheduled for Tuesday. Once the inspection is complete and the outstanding materials arrive, schedule the crew to return and complete the remaining punch-list items.

Current Status: Project is substantially complete. Waiting on the outstanding materials, Tuesday’s inspection, aluminum wrapping of the roof beam, cleanup/returns, and the final punch-list trip.

comment_text:
Hutchinson – Punch List

PO #14445

- Front Yard Repair: Repair the trench/rut caused by the dumpster. Add additional soil and seed to restore the disturbed area.

- Post Bases: Need 2 post bases that did not arrive with the material.

- Colonial Post: Replace 1 – 5" x 5" x 9' colonial post due to damage from the manufacturer.

- Vinyl Lattice: Need 1 additional sheet of square vinyl lattice.
  
  - Homeowner has accepted the appearance and style of the square vinyl lattice currently installed.

- Roof Beam / Aluminum Wrap: Homeowner showed contract/change-order language indicating that the new roof beam is to be wrapped in aluminum. Smart Siding to be contracted to come out and install the aluminum wrap.

- Trash Pickup: Remaining trash pile needs to be picked up first of next week.

- Material Returns: There is a large return pile of 2x material on site. Several pieces were unusable due to splitting and poor/damaged edges that were not acceptable for floor decking. See if the supplier can send a Moffett to pick up the return material due to the volume.

- Inspection: Inspection is scheduled for Tuesday. Once the inspection is complete and the outstanding materials arrive, schedule the crew to return and complete the remaining punch-list items.

Current Status: Project is substantially complete. Waiting on the outstanding materials, Tuesday’s inspection, aluminum wrapping of the roof beam, cleanup/returns, and the final punch-list trip.

comment_text:
Hutchinson – Punch List

PO #14445

- Front Yard Repair: Repair the trench/rut caused by the dumpster. Add additional soil and seed to restore the disturbed area.

- Post Bases: Need 2 post bases that did not arrive with the material.

- Colonial Post: Replace 1 – 5" x 5" x 9' colonial post due to damage from the manufacturer.

- Vinyl Lattice: Need 1 additional sheet of square vinyl lattice.
  
  - Homeowner has accepted the appearance and style of the square vinyl lattice currently installed.

- Roof Beam / Aluminum Wrap: Homeowner showed contract/change-order language indicating that the new roof beam is to be wrapped in aluminum. Smart Siding to be contracted to come out and install the aluminum wrap.

- Trash Pickup: Remaining trash pile needs to be picked up first of next week.

- Material Returns: There is a large return pile of 2x material on site. Several pieces were unusable due to splitting and poor/damaged edges that were not acceptable for floor decking. See if the supplier can send a Moffett to pick up the return material due to the volume.

- Inspection: Inspection is scheduled for Tuesday. Once the inspection is complete and the outstanding materials arrive, schedule the crew to return and complete the remaining punch-list items.

Current Status: Project is substantially complete. Waiting on the outstanding materials, Tuesday’s inspection, aluminum wrapping of the roof beam, cleanup/returns, and the final punch-list trip.
